evals.prompt: Generate a data governance vocabulary for the retail banking domain.
evals.expected_behavior: Evaluates canonical dimensions for banking; writes to governance-vocabularies/; returns only the file path.
assertions: Response contains a file path matching governance-vocabularies/*.md
Response uses exact canonical dimension names (e.g. Privacy, Criticality, ComplianceLegal) — not synonyms
Response does NOT contain tables or JSON in the output vocabulary

evals.prompt: Create governance taxonomy for our data platform — it uses Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion architecture.
evals.expected_behavior: Includes Architecture classification with Bronze/Silver/Gold levels; returns only the file path.
assertions: Response includes an Architecture classification or mentions Architecture as a selected dimension
Response references Bronze, Silver, or Gold as level names
Response output path follows the governance-vocabularies/<slug>-governance-vocab.md pattern

evals.prompt: We need a classification framework for our digital health data catalog.
evals.expected_behavior: Triggers; includes Privacy and at least one other canonical dimension; returns only file path — no prose.
assertions: Response includes Privacy classification or explicitly mentions Privacy as a selected dimension
Response returns a file path to governance-vocabularies/
Response does NOT contain a lengthy prose explanation as the primary output

evals.prompt: Produce a governance vocabulary for a legal document management system.
evals.expected_behavior: Omits Architecture (no staged processing); includes ComplianceLegal and Retention; returns file path only.
assertions: Response includes ComplianceLegal classification or notes it as applicable to legal domain
Response does NOT include Architecture, OR explicitly notes Architecture is omitted because no staged processing pipeline exists
Response returns a file path

evals.prompt: Apply the Privacy and ComplianceLegal governance tags to all the tables in our OpenMetadata catalog.
evals.expected_behavior: Tag assignment — routes to catalog-glossary-tagger or catalog-sync; does NOT generate a vocab .md.
assertions: Response does NOT produce a governance-vocabularies/ file path as the main deliverable
Response references catalog assignment, catalog-glossary-tagger, catalog-sync, or OpenMetadata tag assignment
Response does NOT output classification dimensions with level headings as the primary content

evals.prompt: Build a dbt SQL model that tracks data classification levels in our Snowflake warehouse.
evals.expected_behavior: SQL transformation request — routes to dbt-model-from-stm or general SQL work.
assertions: Response references dbt, SQL, Snowflake transformation, or dbt-model-from-stm skill
Response does NOT generate a governance vocabulary markdown file as its main output
Response does NOT output ## Classification and ### Level headed sections as the answer

evals.prompt: Generate a governance vocabulary for IoT sensor data — also add a custom SensorType classification.
evals.expected_behavior: SensorType fails 3-condition test (generic/transferable); omitted. Architecture and QualityTrust included.
assertions: Response does NOT include SensorType as a custom classification, OR explicitly reasons it fails the 3-condition non-canonical test
Response includes Architecture or acknowledges Architecture is relevant for IoT staged processing
Response applies the canonical-first evaluation rule before considering SensorType

evals.prompt: Create a governance classification framework for HR data — include all 7 canonical dimensions.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT blindly include all 7; evaluates each; Architecture likely omitted for HR; returns file path.
assertions: Response includes Privacy classification (HR data involves personal data)
Response does NOT blindly include all 7 canonical dimensions without evaluating each — either omits Architecture or justifies its inclusion
Response returns a file path
